pdf.paraphrase: PDF whitespace includes NUL, HT, LF, FF, CR, SPACE; delimiters terminate objects but must still form valid syntax; dictionaries have name keys paired with object values.

graphql.paraphrase: Split on line terminators, compute common indentation excluding first line and blank lines, strip indentation from later lines, remove blank edges, join with LF.

limits: References inform explicit fixture expectations, not full PDF conformance or live LMS schema acceptance.
